title: Inventory
description: The inventory object inside a drawer or saved-project response. Array positions identify donors throughout the plan.

photo_url.description: Local route for the normalized drawer photo, when one was saved.

identity.description: Optional stored object identity. Repeated values can identify multiple observations of one donor.

detected_label.description: Original model label retained for duplicate detection when confidence was low.

box_2d.description: [top, left, bottom, right], normalized to 0–1000. Manual items have no image box.

candidate_parts.description: Candidate quantities keyed by component ID. An empty object contributes no units.

duplicate_of.description: Zero-based index of the retained detection in an older saved inventory whose positions must be preserved.
